analyzed_vuln.description: `is_avrule_redundant()` trusts `entry->key.source_type` and `entry->key.target_type` and immediately derives `s_idx = source_type - 1` / `t_idx = target_type - 1`, then indexes `type_map[s_idx]` and `type_map[t_idx]` with no bounds/validity checks. With malformed policy data, these type IDs can be invalid (0 or > p_types.nprim), causing out-of-bounds read of `type_map` and subsequent wild pointer dereference in the nested loop at line ~215 (`type_map[t_idx].count`).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input must compile/load into a policy that reaches `sepol_policydb_optimize()` and contains malformed AV/conditional AV rules with invalid source/target type values. During `policydb_optimize() -> optimize_cond_avtab() -> optimize_cond_av_list()`, the code calls `is_avrule_redundant()` on such an entry; because no validation is done before indexing `type_map`, an OOB read occurs and crashes.
